Class SuokifToExpr

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.parsing.SuokifToExpr
public class SuokifToExpr extends Object
Converts an ANTLR Concrete Syntax Tree (CST) produced by SuokifParser into a clean Expr Abstract Syntax Tree. Once this conversion is done, all ANTLR context objects can be discarded; downstream code uses only the Expr hierarchy. Usage: 
   SuokifVisitor visitor = SuokifVisitor.parseString("(likes John Mary)");
   FormulaAST f = visitor.result.values().iterator().next();
   Expr expr = SuokifToExpr.convert(f.parsedFormula);
